title: Inventory
description: Stock inventory record tracking product availability, quantities, reserved items, and warehouse location. Used for inventory management and stock level monitoring.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inventory record

product_id.description: Foreign key reference to the product this inventory record belongs to

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit - unique identifier for the specific product variant

quantity.description: Current available stock quantity for this product

reserved.description: Number of units reserved for pending orders or holds

location.description: Warehouse or storage location where this inventory is stored

last_updated.description: Timestamp when the inventory quantity was last updated
